parrafo.es: Restaurante y cafetería venezolana en North Miami. Café recién hecho desde temprano, arepas, cachapas y empanadas hechas al momento, con un ambiente de barrio que sus clientes describen una y otra vez como cálido y familiar.
parrafo.en: A Venezuelan restaurant and café in North Miami. Fresh coffee from early on, arepas, cachapas and empanadas made to order, and a neighborhood feel that customers describe again and again as warm and friendly.

hero.imagen_alt: Empanadas venezolanas recién hechas en Dulce Tropical

parrafo_1.es: Dulce Tropical es un restaurante y cafetería venezolana en el corazón de North Miami. Café recién hecho todo el día, arepas, cachapas, empanadas y platos como el pabellón, preparados al momento para quien llega a desayunar, almorzar o simplemente a tomar un café.
parrafo_1.en: Dulce Tropical is a Venezuelan restaurant and café in the heart of North Miami. Fresh coffee all day long, arepas, cachapas, empanadas and dishes like pabellón, made to order for anyone stopping by for breakfast, lunch, or just a coffee.

parrafo_2.es: Con 938 reseñas y 4.7 de calificación en Google, clientes destacan el sabor casero, las porciones generosas y un servicio que se siente de barrio, de los que recuerdan tu pedido.
parrafo_2.en: With 938 reviews and a 4.7 rating on Google, customers highlight the homemade flavor, generous portions and a neighborhood-style service, the kind that remembers your order.

items.quote: Amazing authentic Venezuelan food at a very reasonable price. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and made with care. The staff was super friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend trying the cachapa and the empanadas. So delicious!

The food was absolutely phenomenal! I ordered two pabellón and cheese empanadas, a pabellón arepa with shredded beef, black beans, plantains, and cheese, two Pabellón a Caballo meals, and passion fruit juice. Everything was delicious!

Right off the bat...freshly made coffee (breakfast served all day), menus on smart tablets, and friendly service. The food was fantastic, the coffee was outstanding, and the vibe was that of a small coffee shop.
I was blown away how great this place was. Food amazing, service amazing and they give you big portions that are just delicious!! Definitely coming back!!
